children.name: Google Compute Engine - Activity
children.description: See the details of projects, zones, instances, and message severity in your Google Compute Engine.

panels.name: Top 10 Projects by Messages
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Gcp/ComputeEngine* logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gce_instance" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.protoPayload.resourceName" as resourceName 
| parse regex field=resourcename "projects/\S+/zones/(?<zone>\S+)/instances/(?<instance>\S+)"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id" as project
| count as messages project 
| top 10 project by messages

panels.name: Instance Inserts vs Deletes
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Gcp/ComputeEngine* logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gce_instance" | where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.protoPayload.resourceName" as resourceName 
| parse regex field=resourcename "projects/\S+/zones/(?<zone>\S+)/instances/(?<instance>\S+)"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id" as project
| parse regex "\s+\"methodName\":\"\S+\.compute\.instances\.(?<method>\S+)\""
| timeslice 1m

| if (method = "insert", 1, 0) as insert
| if (method = "delete", 1, 0) as delete

| sum(insert) as inserts, sum(delete) as deletes by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1m)

panels.name: Severe Messages
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Gcp/ComputeEngine* logName resource timestamp
| timeslice 1m
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gce_instance" | where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.protoPayload.resourceName" as resourceName 
| parse regex field=resourcename "projects/\S+/zones/(?<zone>\S+)/instances/(?<instance>\S+)"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id" as project
| json "message.data.severity" as severity
| where severity = "ERROR" or severity = "WARNING" or severity = "CRITICAL" or severity = "EMERGENCY" or severity = "ALERT"
| count by _timeslice, severity
| fillmissing timeslice(1m), values("ERROR", "WARNING", "CRITICAL", "EMERGENCY", "ALERT") in severity
| transpose row _timeslice column severity as *

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Gcp/ComputeEngine* logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gce_instance" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| json "message.data.protoPayload.resourceName" as resourceName 
| parse regex field=resourcename "projects/\S+/zones/(?<zone>\S+)/instances/(?<instance>\S+)"
| json "message.data.resource.labels.project_id", "message.data.protoPayload.methodName", "message.data.severity" as project, method, severity

| if (method matches "*compute.instances.insert", 1, 0) as insert
| if (method matches "*compute.instances.delete", 1, 0) as delete
| if (method matches "*compute.instances.start", 1, 0) as start
| if (method matches "*compute.instances.stop", 1, 0) as stop
| if (method matches "*compute.instances.reset", 1, 0) as reset
| if (severity matches "WARNING", 1, 0) as warning
| if (severity matches "ERROR", 1, 0) as error
| if (severity matches "CRITICAL", 1, 0) as critical
| if (severity matches "ALERT", 1, 0) as alert
| if (severity matches "EMERGENCY", 1, 0) as emergency

| sum(insert) as inserts, sum(delete) as deletes, sum(start) as starts, sum(stop) as stops, sum(reset) as resets, sum(warning) as warnings, sum(error) as errors, sum(critical) as criticals, sum(alert) as alerts, sum(emergency) as emergencies by instance, zone, project
| inserts+deletes+starts+stops+resets as total_activity
| warnings+errors+criticals+alerts+emergencies as total_severity
| fields project, zone, instance, total_activity, inserts, deletes, starts, stops, resets, total_severity, emergencies, alerts, criticals, errors, warnings
| sort by total_activity
